verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state @coderabbitai review performs incremental review of only new changes rather than a full pass, distinguishing it from @coderabbitai full review, directly matching the story of tracking fixes incrementally on new commits. Community evidence corroborates active use of automated PR review triggered by pushes, though none specifically confirm the 'tracks what was fixed' resolution-tracking nuance in hands-on detail. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that old resolved comments are marked fixed rather than just skipped, and more detail on how fixed threads are surfaced/closed.
